name: parallel-adversarial-review
description: Two skills for adversarial code review. parallel-adversarial-review dispatches two same-model reviewer subagents in parallel under a competitive scoring frame, aggregating findings and taking the worst severity on disagreement. multi-model-adversarial-review extends this to N installed coding-agent CLIs (claude, codex, gemini, opencode, amp, aider) with a cross-critique stage that catches hallucinations and severity inflation, then synthesizes a deduplicated report. Includes a fixture-based eval suite that scores precision and recall against planted defects.
